op_cues.text: ♪ Aiming toward the sunset floating on the Nakagawa River ♪
♪ I kicked a pebble, and my shoe flew off with it ♪
♪ It hit someone out jogging right on their back ♪
♪ I bowed my head and apologized: 'Sorry about that!' ♪
♪ Even when I've lost my cheerful spirit somewhere ♪
♪ The familiar, unchanging townscape is strangely kind ♪
♪ From east to west, the sun sets ♪
♪ And another day quietly draws to a close ♪
Episode 51: Profit from the Haunted House!

2: I wonder if kids these days have zero interest in haunted houses.
3:
Well, that's obvious. Kids today are used to insane Hollywood SFX.
If you show them a one-eyed boy or a faceless ghost, they'll just laugh.
5: Special effects. You know, state-of-the-art movie tech!
6: Hey, Ryo-san! Don't spit your watermelon seeds over here!
7:
Still, back when we were kids, we used to really look forward
to haunted houses and tests of courage!
8: Yeah... I guess this annual shopping street tradition is dying out, too.
9: It does feel a bit lonely.
10: Bottom line is, we just need gimmicks that today's kids will actually love!
11: Do you have something in mind?
12: Leave it to me! Nothing is impossible for Kankichi Ryotsu!
13:
How about this? Give me 10% of the food stall sales,
and I'll run the whole show!
15: Ow, ow, ow! That hurts, you bastard!
17: You insolent fool! Asking for a cut when cooperating with citizens?!
20: Chief! Where did you get that shinai?!
21:
I just bought it at the sporting goods store specifically
to discipline troublesome subordinates!
23: Our duty as police officers is to serve our citizens for free!
25: Yes sir, loud and clear, sir!
26: Dammit... working for free in this blistering heat is ridiculous!
27: Besides, no way modern kids will be scared of a one-eyed boy.
28: Don't worry, just leave it to us!
30: I've got complete confidence in this!
31:
I ordered the latest special FX makeup supplies from Hollywood.
It will look shockingly realistic!
33: Yeah, yeah, do whatever you want.
34: Here's what you'll need: plaster, silicone, and a bit of foam latex.
36: First, apply silicone to the face to take a mold.
37:
Next, cast a plaster bust from the mold, and sculpt
the one-eyed monster face on top using clay.
39:
Take a plaster mold, discard the clay, and whip the foam latex
until it's completely smooth and even.
40:
Pour the foam latex evenly into the mold,
then bake it thoroughly in the oven.
41: Feels like we're baking a cake...
42: Open the mold, and there you have it!
43: All that's left is adhering it with glue and painting it!
44: It's super easy, so everyone should try this at home!
46: Wow, that turned out amazingly realistic!
48: Alright! Let's test it out by scaring the Chief!
55: Reiko-san gave him special FX makeup!
56: No way... I can't believe it!
61: Well, free money is free money! Finders keepers!
63: See?! I told you it was me!
65: What on earth is the meaning of this disguise?!
66: I'm participating in tonight's haunted house event!
67:
I didn't even want to do it, but I went through all this
trouble just to help out!
68: Don't bring your face so close! It's revolting!
69: Senpai, we need to head to the venue soon.
71: Are you really going out dressed like that?!
72: I'll give you a ride in my car.
73: Yeah, thanks. If I walked like this, it'd cause a public panic!
75: Terai! Hey, Terai, are you okay?!
83: Let's ask him to take us for a drive!
89: They called out to me first, so I just answered!
94: I'm gonna take a nap till we arrive.
95: Man, I never dreamed we'd snag a Ferrari!
96: We can flip this baby for serious cash!
97: Huh? Was that a groan? Must be hearing things.
98: Man, Nakagawa's driving got awfully reckless...
100: I saw something weird in the rearview mirror!
104: Wait, are you those car thieves from the news?!
110: Help us, officer! Please arrest us!
116: Those canine patrol cops stole all my credit!
117: Shoot, I gotta hurry or the haunted house will start without me!
120: Phew, made it just in time.
121: Let's see, do I have any loose change?
123: Running off like he just saw a ghost...
126: I'm still wearing this ultra-realistic monster makeup!
127: If I cause a panic in town, the Chief will beat me to a pulp!
130: If they catch me looking like this, I'm done for!
131: Phew... managed to shake them off somehow.
132: Now then, what am I gonna do?
133: Another taxi? Guess I've got no choice.
134: I'll take a gamble and hail one!
136: Yes? How may I help you?
137: See? If you look closely, you can tell it's just makeup!
138: Everyone's making such a fuss, it's a real pain.
139: Man, what a relief! Glad I got an understanding driver!
141: Take me to Manpuku Temple, please!
143: It's awfully dead quiet around here...
146: He sped off before I even paid the fare!
147: Well, fine by me—free ride for Ryo-san!
148: It's pitch black, I can barely see my feet.
149: Whoever's holding that lantern, thanks for being thoughtful!
150: Sorry I'm late, everyone! My bad, my bad!
152: Oh, the old lady from the candy store?
153: With makeup that thick, no wonder you can barely see!
154: Your arms should be positioned a bit more like this!
156: You're participating in the event too?
161: Whoa, look at that! Everyone's got insane makeup!
162: Hard to believe this is just a shopping street festival!
163: Alright, I'll hide over on that side! Let's scare the pants off these kids!
164: Just watch, I'll make 'em wet themselves!
166: Where were you all of last night?!
168: I was waiting at Manpuku Temple the entire night!
169: Not a single customer showed up!
172:
Ryo-chan, the test of courage wasn't at Manpuku Temple,
it was at Bunpuku Temple!
175: Look, it's written right here on the flyer!
177: Wait, but I met the other ghost performers there!
178: Manpuku Temple is an abandoned ruin! Nobody should be there!
179: Then... who was it that I met?!
180: Don't tell me you're claiming you met real ghosts?!
183: They were way too realistic for the local merchants!
185: In this modern scientific age, ghosts don't exist!
187: You probably slacked off, got late,
188: and made up this clumsy excuse to cover it up!
190: Speaking of which, there was a ghost panic in town last night.
191: That wouldn't happen to be your doing, would it?!
194: I swear on my badge, my story is 100% true!
198: I'd gladly pay cold hard cash to see them!
200: If I exploit those real ghosts...!
203: Every single ghost is 100% genuine! You can even shake hands!
204: It'll be the talk of the town for generations!
205: Plus 'Ghost Purikura' photo booths where you take photos with real spirits!
206: And 'Obaketchi' virtual pets where you raise your own ghost!
207: And a giant leisure theme park...
208: where you can play with real ghosts!
215: I'll become a multi-billionaire, no doubt about it!
216: I'll make back thousands of times what the Chief made me lose!
218: Hey! You're the ghost! Don't look at my face and scream!
219: It's me! The one-eyed monster from yesterday!
221: Yesterday was just special FX makeup! Look, see?
223: So... you were actually a human being?!
224: Aw man, we totally thought you were one of us!
226: Why are you moping around here, especially when you're real ghosts?!
227: If you're bored, go into town and haunt some people!
228: Well, you see... nowadays everywhere is brightly lit even late at night.
229:
People are glued to cell phones and games.
Even if we stand right behind them, they don't care!
230: Modern folks have too many distractions!
231: Our scaring business is completely ruined!
233: Pathetic! It's the end of the world! You call yourselves ghosts?!
234: A ghost's whole worth comes from terrifying people!
235:
Alright! From now on, I will put you through boot camp
so you can be proud ghouls!
236: Got it?! Any complaints?! / None, sir!
245: You can't hit the target with arrows like that!
249: Are you mocking me?! Put some spine into it!
255: You thought this would be easy?! Next up: 500 rabbit hops! Let's go!
256: Tomorrow is opening night! Multi-billionaire status is right in front of me!
258: What happened to you?! Your face is completely pale! Are you sick?
259:
Really? My body feels fine to me. / You look awfully gaunt!
Look, you haven't even eaten half of your pork cutlet bowl!
260:
Normally, you'd eat that plus ramen and yakisoba!
Sometimes you even add a tempura bowl and soba!
261: Nah, I just don't have much appetite. It's boiling hot every day, that's all.
262: We should consult the Chief about this... / Yeah, let's do that.
264: Let's follow him! / Tomorrow is opening day!
265:
I want to see the results of your training! Today is our final rehearsal, so it'll be extra strict!
Wait... those are real ghosts!
266:
What Ryo-chan said was actually true!
Senpai is being possessed by evil spirits!
267: At this rate, they might drain his life away! Chief, what should we do?!
273: Indeed! The shadow of death is already written across your face!
275: If you go back to those ghosts tonight, you will surely be possessed and killed!
276: Crap! If my scheme gets exposed now, all my investment goes down the drain!
277: Why would I listen to a shady priest like you?!
279: Our temple possesses sacred exorcism rites passed down for generations!
280: Listen to him, Ryotsu! It's for your own good!
282: Even if you hate it, we cannot stand by and watch you die!
330: I cannot write sacred warding kanji without intense concentration!
332: Don't look up the kanji in a dictionary!
336: Eloim, Essaim... Fulfill our pact! Gachon, gachon!
340: Evil spirits begone! Evil spirits begone!
341: Purify this vessel! Cleanse this soul!
348: Evil spirits begone! Evil spirits begone!
349: In the name of the Moon, I will punish you!
352: Gachon! Evil spirits begone! Evil spirits begone!
353: In the name of the Moon, I will punish you!
363: I took out massive loans to fund that haunted house!
365: Hey, guys! Did you come to rescue me?!
373: Alright! Let's rush straight to the venue!
380: What are you talking about, you guys?!
382: What is the meaning of this?
383: You can't possibly be scared of that fake exorcism!
384: Umm... actually, we came here to resign from this job!
385: We know Ryo-san is super enthusiastic, but we just can't keep up with him!
386: His boot camp training is way too brutal!
387: Wait... you mean you weren't haunting Ryotsu?
388: No way! HE was haunting US!
389: The real demonic monster of greed is that man!
390: WHAT?! What about the 1,225,000 yen I borrowed and sank into this?!
391: I'm not letting you quit now!
396:
The gorgeous Corvette driver I hit on along the Shuto Expressway
turned out to be Maria's mom?!
397: Wait, that means she's Chief Honda's wife?!
398:
The ward office might forgive this,
but Kankichi Ryotsu will never allow it!
399: Next time: 'The Gorgeous Wife Is Super Extreme!' Look forward to it!
